criteria.description: Correctness of bucket lowering count: for each row count the 1s and add ceil(count/capacity) to total, matching the three docstring examples (6, 5, 0). A different correct algorithm gets full credit.

Boundary cases and robustness in the stated domain (capacity >=1, grid of 0/1): empty grid or empty rows returns 0, all-zero grid returns 0, capacity=1 returns total ones, large grid (100x100) terminates. No infinite loops, no crash/exception on valid inputs; crash or non-termination on valid input is severe.

Code validity and readability: returned body is syntactically valid Python, first line indented to fit inside def max_fill, uses simple iteration and math.ceil or equivalent integer ceil division, no extraneous I/O.
